response.rationale: R1 best fits the cisternal, non-enhancing, well-circumscribed, CSF-like T1/T2 hyperintense lesion with CT isodensity and no calcification; R5 shares cisternal location and circumscription but the explicit absence of enhancement strongly contradicts meningioma, which is expected to enhance. R2/R3/R4 are weaker because their usual diagnoses require enhancement and/or different location profiles. Although absent diffusion restriction is atypical for epidermoid cyst, R1 is the only option compatible with the strong no-enhancement polarity.

rejected.why: Hemangioblastoma would typically enhance avidly and usually arises in cerebellar parenchyma rather than as a non-enhancing cisternal mass; absent enhancement is a decisive contradiction.
Only location and circumscription support neurofibroma; it would be expected to enhance and is not a characteristic isolated cerebellomedullary cistern mass.
Cisternal location and circumscription are nonspecific, and schwannoma almost always enhances; absent enhancement and no nerve-associated pattern make it unlikely.
